items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1958-11-14
items.q: And the old Johnny Brown, when he used to play clarinet, his son, his name is John, instead of Johnny, it's John, it's John. He was playing piano.

ctx.x: We'll ask Pickett. Yeah, we'll see him someday.
